primary.measurements: Proteus weak4.27micron CO2 absorption marginally stronger trailing; deep3micron OH absorption and no clear water-ice bands. Nondetection is not proof of absolute absence. Proteus either lacks or has much weaker2.72micron feature than Larissa/Galatea/rings; do not assign their stronger magnesium-phyllosilicate signature to Proteus.
primary.interpretations: Hydrated carrier unidentified. Tentative3.07micron ammonia-bearing interpretation, but Proteus strength argues against ammoniated phyllosilicate carrier. Aqueous alteration, impact dehydration, primordial-satellite destruction/reaccretion and tidally shredded KBO alternatives are models, not current liquid water, directly observed history, local fractions, plumes/ocean/biology. Ceres/meteorite analogies do not authorize skins.
primary.limits: Scattered Neptune light/custom reduction, sensitivity outside1.7–4.5microns, unresolved disk spectra not visible terrain or Voyager pixel chemistry. Final record/licence, raw products, calibration and dynamical history audit open.
